scripts.build: pnpm run build:pi && pnpm -r --filter "@yuanpu-agent/*" --filter "!@yuanpu-agent/monorepo" run build
scripts.build:pi: node scripts/hydrate-pi-model-data.mjs && pnpm --dir packages/chord run build && pnpm --dir packages/tui run build && pnpm --dir packages/telemetry run build && pnpm --dir packages/ai run build:offline && pnpm --dir packages/durable run build && pnpm --dir packages/agent run build && pnpm --dir packages/session-backends/sqlite-node run build && pnpm --dir packages/protocol run build && pnpm --dir packages/client run build && pnpm --dir packages/server run build && pnpm --dir packages/coding-agent run build
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:yuanpu && pnpm run check:server && pnpm run test
scripts.generate:server: node server/scripts/go.mjs generate && pnpm --filter @yuanpu-agent/server-client run generate
scripts.check:server: node server/scripts/check-generated.mjs && node server/scripts/go.mjs vet && node server/scripts/go.mjs test && pnpm run build:server && pnpm --filter @yuanpu-agent/server-client run build && pnpm --filter @yuanpu-agent/server-client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @yuanpu-agent/server-client run test && pnpm run smoke:server
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native && pnpm run smoke:native && pnpm --filter @yuanpu-agent/desktop run package
scripts.presmoke:native: pnpm run prepare:python-capabilities && pnpm run build:python-artifact && pnpm run smoke:python-artifact
scripts.smoke:native: pnpm --filter @yuanpu-agent/runtime run smoke:native && pnpm run smoke:runtime-update
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:pi && pnpm run typecheck:yuanpu
